decisions.statement: A tick that outruns its ceiling loses the race rather than running on unwatched.
A ceiling reached is told apart from any other throw by its own error name.
A tick asked for after the stop was asked is refused before that tick starts.
A timer left behind holds the process up.
Every race clears its own timer.
A listener left on the signal outlives the tick.
Every race takes its own listener off.

definition: the ceiling a single tick of a long-running service runs under
